description: This pie chart, titled "Distribution of data source in the combined training set," visually represents the proportional contribution of various data sources to a combined training set, with ten distinct categories shown as slices. The largest segment is a large blue slice labeled "SCIFACT" at 31.3%. Following this, a teal slice labeled "FEVER" accounts for 16.1%, and an orange slice labeled "SNLI" represents 15.4%. Other notable segments include a red slice for "MULTINLI" at 11.3%, a light teal slice for "VITAMINC" at 13.0%, and a smaller orange slice for "ANLI" at 4.6%. Smaller segments include "FACTCC" at 2.6%, "ENTFA" at 1.8%, "SCITAIL" at 1.2%, "PUBHEALTH" at 0.5%, and "XSUMHUL" at 1.6%. The smallest segment, "ENTFA," is a very thin yellow slice at 0.1%. Each category is labeled with its name and percentage value, connected by lines to its corresponding slice, and the chart includes a legend with a gray square corresponding to the 31.3% value for SCIFACT. The slices are arranged in a clockwise descending order by size, starting from the largest (SCIFACT) at the top right.
